config.pasture.title: Pasture
config.pasture.milkNeedsGrazing.tooltip: Cows, goats and mooshrooms go dry after milking and refill by eating grass.
config.pasture.milkBottles.tooltip: Glass bottles milk animals; buckets don't.
config.pasture.passiveEggLaying.tooltip: Keep vanilla's egg laying. Breeding chickens still drops eggs.
config.pasture.animalsEatDroppedFood.too: Adult animals ready to breed walk over to their breeding food on the ground and eat one item, which puts them in love mode.
